cases.why: the radius goes back to a fixed 11 units, which is 22 CSS px only when the chart happens to render at 470px wide -- right on one laptop, under 24 on every phone.
max becomes min, so on a wide chart the halo shrinks below the size it has always had, and on a narrow one it stays too small -- wrong in both directions while the code still reads as a clamp.
the halos are sized once, at load, while Model Lab is hidden and the chart measures 0 wide -- so they keep the base radius for good, and opening the page changes nothing.
the radius is rounded to the nearest hundredth instead of up, which can leave a halo at 23.99px -- under the line by an amount nobody would see and a checker would.
